title: Google\Cloud\WebRisk\V1beta1\ThreatEntryAdditions
name: ThreatEntryAdditions
description: Contains the set of entries to add to a local database.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.raw_hashes
params.description: The raw SHA256-formatted entries. Repeated to allow returning sets of hashes with different prefix sizes.

params.name: data.rice_hashes
params.description: The encoded 4-byte prefixes of SHA256-formatted entries, using a Golomb-Rice encoding. The hashes are converted to uint32, sorted in ascending order, then delta encoded and stored as encoded_data.

methods.name: getRiceHashes
methods.description: The encoded 4-byte prefixes of SHA256-formatted entries, using a Golomb-Rice encoding. The hashes are converted to uint32, sorted in ascending order, then delta encoded and stored as encoded_data.
